method:
YAK's Sharp Picks + YAK's Lottos: a daily card built from betting splits, line movement and our models,
locked once a day and graded automatically. Writes data/yak_picks.json (picks + full history).

SHARP PICKS (3-10 a day, units 5/4/3/2/1)
  Candidates: every moneyline, spread and total on today's games (PT day) in every sport we cover, using
  DraftKings' own splits (and SportsBettingDime's multi-book consensus where it exists, pro leagues).
  Score for one side of one market:
      0.6 x (DK money% - bets%)                     the "money heavier than tickets" tell (needs >= GAP_MIN)
    + 8  consensus also money-heavy on this side      / dropped if the consensus is money-heavy the OTHER way
    + line move toward this side since the open      (+4/pt spread, +3/pt total, +100 x implied-prob for ML)
      ... and the same penalty when it moved away     (reverse line movement against the side)
    + model edge in this side's direction            (x sport weight: the models with a track record count more)
  Out (11/19/26 filters): thin markets (money above 95% or below 5%, or exactly 50% of tickets: a handful of
  bets, often one big one), the line moving AGAINST the side, and our model saying the side loses. Also out: moneylines outside -250..+300 (one big ticket on a longshot isn't "sharp"),
  games already started, and games whose own flags point opposite ways (ML one side, spread the other).
  One pick per game (correlated legs are one bet). Qualify at score >= SCORE_MIN; take 3-10.
  Units: 10% 5U / 20% 4U / 30% 3U / 30% 2U / 10% 1U with minimums 1/1/2/2/1, filled from the top so a
  short slate drops the 1U and 2U tiers first.

YAK'S LOTTOS (0.25U, about 4-10 a day, only if they price as +EV)
  Moneylines from +750 to +4000. Our model's win probability is shrunk toward the no-vig book price
  (long-shot tails are where models are least trustworthy) and the pick needs EV >= LOTTO_EV_MIN after
  that. No padding: a day with two +EV long shots gets two. (Alt spreads: no priced feed available yet.)

LEANS -> OFFICIAL CARD (Parker's spec, 11/19/26)
  7 AM-1 PM PT: every build refreshes an unofficial Leans board (not tracked). A lean on a game that tips
  before 1 PM becomes an OFFICIAL 3U play (lottos at their 0.25U) once the game is within 75 minutes of tip.
  The first build at/after 1 PM publishes the official card from the games still to start (early locks count
  toward the 3-10 plays); it never changes afterwards. The tracker counts early locks + the 1 PM card.
  Cards from before 11/20/26 locked once at 7 AM (no "status" field) and are official as stored.
GRADING Every build grades finished picks from the sports' own
  results, at the price taken, and records closing-line value from the ledgers.
